description: Cart-pole with LQR feedback (4D), finite horizon: the pole-tip coordinate x1 + sin(x3) never reaches 3.7 inside the box [-0.06, 4] x [-0.88, 0.7] x [-0.83, 0.66] x [-1.72, 2.82].
notes: The initial set is a single state (degenerate box).

State x = (p, v, theta, omega): cart position and velocity, pole angle (counter-clockwise, zero hanging down, positive with the pole mass towards positive p) and angular velocity; Tedrake's cart-pole as printed. u = -K x is the LQR state feedback (gains k1..k4) designed by scripts/cartpole_lqr.py with Q = diag(56.5349, 27.434, 1.8689, 77.9197), R = 6.6884.

The target is restricted to the box [-0.06, 4] x [-0.88, 0.7] x [-0.83, 0.66] x [-1.72, 2.82], which lies in the basin of attraction of the LQR equilibrium (needed by eigenfunction-based methods; checked by simulating samples of the target, scripts/cartpole_lqr.py --basin); the unrestricted pole-tip region extends to states that do not converge.
